name: The Home Counties
description: An extraction shooter for 1-4 players in a near-future Britain at war.
tagline: The government moved on. The gangs moved in. Take what you can carry from Bletchley's empty streets, and reach the red smoke before the clock runs out...

story.heading: How it got this way

beats.title: Britain kept the war supplied
beats.text: Russia launched a full-scale invasion into Europe, and Britain became NATO's logistics hub. American and allied troops, vehicles, rifles, helmets and body armour came through its ports, airbases and depots by the shipload.

beats.title: Russia paid for trouble
beats.text: Britain was already divided, worn down by COVID, heatwaves, cyberattacks and one political crisis after another. Russia saw a chance to cut the link between Europe and the US, and quietly funded criminal gangs and dissident groups, each with its own agenda.

beats.title: The Home Counties
beats.text: The counties around London were made a protective barrier for the capital, and a Civilian Protection and Continuity Zone for people displaced by the fighting.

beats.title: The strikes
beats.text: Russian forces captured a key port in Rotterdam and launched ballistic missile strikes on the south of the UK, London included. As a result, the Home Counties plan fell apart.

beats.title: Bletchley
beats.text: The government relocated to Bletchley Park, and the streets around it were evacuated. Then the government moved on. Criminals and opportunists moved in.

story.outro: The story is left lying around the street: leaflets on the doormats, cards in the windows, letters and notes in the houses, and the soldiers' logs at the checkpoints. Take them home and pin them up.

trailer.title: The Home Counties: A dev tour

cta.heading: Early days
cta.text: The Home Counties is in early development, with an early access alpha on the way. New builds, maps and weapons are written up in the dev log as they're added.

features.title: Old streets
features.text: The first map is a corner of Bletchley built from Duncombe Street, Osborne Street, Water Eaton Road, Oliver Road, Clifford Avenue and the old Sainsbury's, beside the West Coast Main Line.

features.title: Loot and extract
features.text: Eighteen-minute raids. Search the houses people left in a hurry, the crates and the scavs you drop. Extract before the timer ends, or lose what you were carrying.

features.title: Scavs
features.text: Gang members, chancers and the odd few who never left. They're armed, they take cover, flank in pairs, throw grenades and come to investigate when they hear you.

features.title: Noise
features.text: Sprinting, gunfire and moving through long grass all make noise. Walking, crouching and leaning round corners keep you quieter.

features.title: Gear and weight
features.text: US Army plate carriers next to Russian helmets: NATO kit came through Britain by the shipload, and the gangs brought AKs. Eight gear slots and four pockets, and the more you carry, the slower you move.

features.title: Left behind
features.text: Nobody has cut a hedge since the evacuation. Knee-high grass, ivy, wrecked cars, boarded-up houses, a looted pub, and council leaflets still on the doormats.

features.title: Squads
features.text: Raid alone or with up to three friends, through Steam with no port forwarding. Shared loot, friendly fire, and your squad can carry your kit out if you go down.

features.title: Four traders
features.text: Chalky, Carl, Crapper and Sofie buy, sell and hand out work from behind their ID cards. Earn their trust for new tasks, better stock, special orders and a tab at the doctor's.

features.title: The gunsmith
features.text: Put your AK on the bench: a red dot or a picture-in-picture 4x scope, a suppressor, a stock or none, and watch its handling change before you buy a part.

loop.title: Gear up
loop.text: Choose a loadout in your hideout, buy what you need from the traders and set up your rifle at the gunsmith. Anything you take in can be lost.

loop.title: Deploy
loop.text: Alone or with up to three friends, you start at the west or east end of Water Eaton Road, picked at random, in that raid's own weather and hour.

loop.title: Loot
loop.text: Search crates, houses and dead scavs, and take the papers people left behind. Keep an eye on your carry weight.

loop.title: Extract
loop.text: The army left its checkpoints when it pulled out. Reach one, find the red smoke and stay in the zone for ten seconds. If you die, you lose everything you were carrying.
